title: Engineering Configuration Data Requirement Sheet

rows.category: A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
rows.name: Target SynerGEE product / version
rows.purpose: Confirm the receiving installation can interpret the schema and equipment references. SAI_Control.Product must match the approved template.
rows.format: Exact product/version text; template registry value
rows.sample: Reference: SynerGEE Electric 5.0.0.324
rows.remark: Mandatory full mode. Reference version is known; actual receiving version needs confirmation. [EPB, WR]

rows.category: A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
rows.name: Clean approved MDB template
rows.purpose: Provide a genuine empty network template with the approved fields, indexes and relationships, then register and approve it.
rows.format: Jet MDB file; template code/version; approved registry selection
rows.sample: Reference structure: 50 tables, 1,065 fields, 133 indexes, 41 relationships
rows.remark: Mandatory. Schema is available; an approved clean template and review are still required. Hash is generated by the application. [EC, WR]

rows.category: A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
rows.name: Installed conductor library revision
rows.purpose: Identify the exact external library revision that resolves the conductor IDs used in the exported network.
rows.format: Versioned library name/revision or controlled release identifier
rows.sample: Not embedded in reference MDBs
rows.remark: Mandatory approval input. An equipment ID list is not the actual conductor library. [EC, NV]

rows.category: A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
rows.name: Installed transformer library revision
rows.purpose: Identify the exact external transformer library containing the approved winding, impedance and loss definitions.
rows.format: Versioned library name/revision or controlled release identifier
rows.sample: Not embedded in reference MDBs
rows.remark: Mandatory approval input. Transformer make or kVA label does not identify a library revision. [EC, NV]

rows.category: A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
rows.name: Approved conductor model inventory
rows.purpose: Provide the installed electrical definitions and literal IDs for every material/size used on an active R/Y/B/N position.
rows.format: Reviewed library package plus exact ID list; native library units declared
rows.sample: Observed IDs: ANT, DOG, GNAT, WASP, INSULATED ANT; leading-space variants
rows.remark: Mandatory for conductors actually used. R/X, ratings and other model data come from the library; GPX/PDF codes do not provide them. [MDB, NV]

rows.category: A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
rows.name: Approved transformer model inventory
rows.purpose: Provide installed models whose winding ratings and electrical characteristics are confirmed for the surveyed transformers.
rows.format: Reviewed transformer library package and exact type IDs
rows.sample: Observed labels: 50 KVA, 100 KVA, 200 KVA
rows.remark: Mandatory for selected types. References contain names, not the model definitions or physical specifications. [MDB, EC]

rows.category: A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
rows.name: Approved line-construction model inventory
rows.purpose: Confirm the configuration library definition is installed and suitable for the actual construction, not only that its name exists.
rows.format: Exact configuration IDs and reviewed library definitions
rows.sample: Reference ID: 12.5/7.2 kV cross arm C2-2
rows.remark: Mandatory. The voltage-looking part of an ID is not proof of the actual supply voltage. [MDB, EC, EPB]

rows.category: A. Approval, template and installed equipment libraries
rows.name: Current-project engineering approval and design basis
rows.purpose: Confirm which historical reference conventions apply to this project and approve the completed engineering configuration.
rows.format: Controlled design/review reference and authorized approval; app records user/date
rows.sample: Source models include historical MEPCO networks; no HAZECO engineering approval inferred
rows.owner: Chief Engineer / System Planning / Authorized Admin
rows.remark: Mandatory full mode. Do not manually fabricate approval IDs or dates; use the existing approval workflow. [EC, NV]

rows.category: B. Coordinate reference system and supply voltages
rows.name: Projected CRS and zone confirmation
rows.purpose: Select the metre-based projected CRS for the actual survey and resolve the reference-label versus coordinate discrepancy.
rows.format: Projected EPSG integer; units metres; verified GPX/control-point comparison
rows.sample: MDB label implies EPSG:32643; GPX 591 matches EPSG:32642 within 0.46 m
rows.remark: Mandatory unresolved conflict. The same point differs by about 577 km under zone 43N. Do not copy the label without GIS confirmation. [GEO, EC]

rows.category: B. Coordinate reference system and supply voltages
rows.name: CRS name matching the approved EPSG
rows.purpose: Supply the projection name written to SAI_Control.ProjectionFile, consistent with the chosen coordinates and EPSG.
rows.format: Text, maximum 255 characters in the form
rows.sample: Reference: WGS 1984 UTM Zone 43N; label alone is not validated
rows.remark: Mandatory form field. Current-project EPSG and name must agree; see CRS conflict. [EC, MDB, GEO]

rows.category: B. Coordinate reference system and supply voltages
rows.name: Operating frequency
rows.purpose: Confirm the current-project operating frequency used by the receiving electrical models and libraries.
rows.format: Numeric Hz; form accepts 50 or 60
rows.sample: All nine reference control rows: 60 Hz
rows.remark: Mandatory. Recorded 60 Hz is source evidence, not approval for this project. [EC, MDB]

rows.category: B. Coordinate reference system and supply voltages
rows.name: Primary supply nominal voltage, line-to-line
rows.purpose: Set the feeder nominal voltage in InstFeeders.NominalKvll and keep it consistent with the transformer supply model.
rows.format: Positive numeric kV line-to-line; form maximum 1,000 kV
rows.sample: Reference: 11 kV; BusVoltageLevel separately 11.37
rows.owner: System Planning / Grid or Distribution Operations
rows.remark: Mandatory. Do not use the separate bus operating voltage as nominal voltage without approval. [EC, EPB, MDB]

rows.category: B. Coordinate reference system and supply voltages
rows.name: LT secondary voltage, line-to-line
rows.purpose: Provide actual LT nominal voltage. The form writes this value into InstPrimaryTransformers.SpecNomKv.
rows.format: Positive numeric kV line-to-line; consistent with NomKvMode and library
rows.sample: Actual LT voltage unresolved. Reference stores SpecNomKv=4.16 with NomKvMode=C
rows.remark: Mandatory unresolved input. Previous 0.4kV Data Entry export convention is not an approval for the final SynerGEE model. [EC, MDB]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Selected line configuration library ID
rows.purpose: Select an installed, approved construction ID for the sections; the module applies its central selection to the model.
rows.format: Exact case/space-sensitive reviewed ID; form maximum 200 characters
rows.sample: Reference: 12.5/7.2 kV cross arm C2-2
rows.remark: Mandatory selection; physical applicability still requires approval. Must exist in approved template references. [EC, EPB]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Phase-to-phase spacing and source-unit interpretation
rows.purpose: Confirm actual phase spacing and the meaning of the source MUL number before it is stored in the form field labelled cm.
rows.format: Positive numeric centimetres in this form; source unit interpretation confirmed
rows.sample: Reference raw PhaseToPhaseSpacing_MUL=121.9
rows.remark: Mandatory form input. Source declares Metric globally but gives no field-level unit annotation. No conversion assumed. [EC, MDB]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Phase-to-neutral spacing and source-unit interpretation
rows.purpose: Confirm the spacing used for neutral/phase construction and its unit interpretation in the selected configuration.
rows.format: Positive numeric centimetres in this form
rows.sample: Reference raw PhaseToNeutralSpacing_MUL=91.4
rows.remark: Mandatory form input; construction applicability and units need confirmation. [EC, MDB]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Average conductor height above ground
rows.purpose: Provide the design height used by the line model; do not substitute a pole length without an approved interpretation.
rows.format: Positive numeric metres; form maximum 200 m
rows.sample: Reference AveHeightAboveGround_MUL=9.1 under Metric convention
rows.remark: Mandatory form input. Reference model height is available; surveyed pole height is a different quantity. [EC, MDB]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Survey pole-height unit confirmation
rows.purpose: Confirm how original handwritten heights and older records are interpreted, so height conversions are consistent.
rows.format: ft or m; current new PDF entries are stored in ft
rows.sample: Current application entry policy: feet; MDB model height does not prove paper-form units
rows.remark: Mandatory form choice. Confirm legacy/source units separately; retain original observations. [EC, PDF, UI]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Transformer supply conductor library ID
rows.purpose: Select the approved supply conductor model and settle its exact identity in the installed library.
rows.format: Exact conductor ID in approved template reference inventory
rows.sample: Supply R/B: DOG; Y: one leading space plus DOG
rows.remark: Mandatory form selection. Resolve literal aliases rather than silently trimming source IDs. [EC, MDB]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Transformer secondary-link conductor library ID
rows.purpose: Select the installed conductor for the modeled secondary link, separately from distribution span materials.
rows.format: Exact conductor ID in approved template reference inventory
rows.sample: Link R/B: ANT; Y: one leading space plus ANT
rows.remark: Mandatory form selection. This family choice does not resolve the blank link neutral. [EC, MDB]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Surveyed kVA capacity to approved transformer type
rows.purpose: Provide a type selection for every capacity present in the current survey; confirm the type represents the actual equipment.
rows.format: JSON object: positive kVA capacity keys mapped to exact library IDs
rows.sample: Candidate labels only: {"50":"50 KVA","100":"100 KVA","200":"200 KVA"}
rows.remark: Mandatory mapping. Label-derived candidates need library confirmation; add any additional surveyed capacities through reviewed models. [EC, EPB]

rows.category: C. Line construction and equipment selection
rows.name: Transformer impedance source mode
rows.purpose: Choose whether SynerGEE uses the approved library model or explicit instance impedance values.
rows.format: UseInstanceImpedance integer: 0 for library, 1 for instance values
rows.sample: All nine transformer instances: UseInstanceImpedance=0
rows.remark: Mandatory explicit mode. Recorded PercentImpedance=0 / PercentResistance=0 are not physical zero-impedance evidence. [EC, EPB, MDB]

rows.category: D. Survey interpretation and load-method decisions
rows.name: Two-digit survey-year interpretation window
rows.purpose: Define how DDMMYY dates in complete waypoint IDs resolve to four-digit years.
rows.format: Integer starting year; form range 1800-9900
rows.sample: No source policy. A start of 2000 would interpret 00-99 as 2000-2099
rows.remark: Mandatory form choice. This is an explanatory policy example, not an approved value; model years 2015-2025 do not establish it. [EC]

rows.category: D. Survey interpretation and load-method decisions
rows.name: Approved load-demand method
rows.purpose: Choose measured/verified per-phase demand or a centrally approved category-rate estimation method.
rows.format: manual or category_rates
rows.sample: No approved method recovered; 341 of 350 positive phase records are near 3 kVA/customer
rows.remark: Mandatory method decision. Nine phase records differ; every positive-kVA phase has zero kW/kvar in references. [EC, MDB]

rows.category: D. Survey interpretation and load-method decisions
rows.name: Blank consumer-cell interpretation for final generation
rows.purpose: Confirm whether a blank means unresolved information or an explicitly approved zero under the selected final-generation method.
rows.format: Boolean blank_consumers_zero: false or true, with review basis
rows.sample: PDFs contain blanks; final-generation approval is not recorded in MDBs
rows.remark: Mandatory explicit policy. Independent Data Entry MDB zero-filling does not approve this final-model policy. [EC, NV]

rows.category: D. Survey interpretation and load-method decisions
rows.name: Demand methodology and allocation approval reference
rows.purpose: Document the demand basis and allocation rule so section loads are reproducible and reviewed.
rows.format: Text evidence, form maximum 4,000 characters; authorized review
rows.sample: References use fractional equal customer equivalents; app category method balances whole customers R/Y/B
rows.remark: Mandatory. Counts alone are not demand; source fractional allocation must not be copied as an approved integer allocation. [EC, NV]

rows.category: E. Current network source and transformer connection mapping
rows.name: Approved source-node and terminal mapping
rows.purpose: Specify current feeder/transformer connection aliases and bind physical source nodes to verified current survey coordinates.
rows.format: mapping.networks[code].source_nodes list; unique aliases and valid waypoint links
rows.sample: References show feeder, HV and LV model nodes; no current-project binding approval
rows.remark: Mandatory full model per transformer. GPX locates points; it does not establish the electrical source or synthetic terminal geometry. [EPB, NV]

rows.category: E. Current network source and transformer connection mapping
rows.name: Approved source sections and explicit lengths
rows.purpose: Define the source-to-transformer and secondary-link edges, phases, conductor IDs and modeling lengths.
rows.format: source_sections list; valid from/to aliases; SectionLength_MUL in metres, nonnegative
rows.sample: Reference supply/link lengths: 1 m with one-unit node offsets
rows.remark: Mandatory full model. Historical one-metre links are modeling examples, not surveyed current lengths. [EPB]

rows.category: E. Current network source and transformer connection mapping
rows.name: Feeder-source alias selection
rows.purpose: Choose which source node is the feeder origin for connectivity checks and feeder creation.
rows.format: feeder_node: exact alias from current source_nodes
rows.sample: Historical source alias/name varies by reference feeder
rows.remark: Mandatory per-transformer source mapping. Final database node IDs are generated by the application, not supplied manually. [EPB]

rows.category: E. Current network source and transformer connection mapping
rows.name: Primary transformer section selection
rows.purpose: Identify the approved source section on which the transformer instance must be attached.
rows.format: transformer_section: exact key from source_sections
rows.sample: Reference transformer is attached to its first supply section
rows.remark: Mandatory. Must resolve to an approved current section; do not copy historical section IDs. [EPB]

rows.category: E. Current network source and transformer connection mapping
rows.name: Source-section phase and conductor schedule
rows.purpose: Provide the exact R/Y/B/N positions on each modeled source/link edge, including absent phases.
rows.format: SectionPhases fixed slots; e.g. RYB, RYBN, R BN; separate conductor IDs
rows.sample: Supply: RYB; secondary link: RYBN in references
rows.remark: Mandatory for full source-section validation. An active N requires an actual approved neutral ID. [EPB]

rows.category: E. Current network source and transformer connection mapping
rows.name: Current substation identifier in feeder mapping
rows.purpose: Confirm the current substation identity used by the source-feeder mapping; historical names are not current identifiers.
rows.format: Nonblank SubstationId string within canonical MDB field size
rows.sample: Historical example: 132 KVA K.Wala; not a current HAZECO assignment
rows.remark: Mandatory nonblank identifier. PDF headers help identify assets; official mapping requires verification. [EPB, PDF]

rows.category: E. Current network source and transformer connection mapping
rows.name: Reviewed mapping version and current-network wiring
rows.purpose: Review reusable table values and complete the per-transformer wiring in the existing supported mapping contract.
rows.format: synergee-reviewed-v1 or v2; explicit supported table dictionaries; current networks object
rows.sample: 133 common technical observations; no approved current-network source wiring
rows.owner: Network Studies / SynerGEE Administrator / Application Admin
rows.remark: Mandatory full mode. v2 is required when exporting supported meter/PV records. Approval metadata is recorded by the application. [EC, EPB, SM]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Exact conductor IDs for unmatched PDF materials
rows.purpose: Resolve a printed or handwritten material to the installed conductor model only when that material is actually used.
rows.format: Per-material exact ID crosswalk and technical library definition
rows.sample: PDF legend includes PVC variants and ABC 50/95 mm²; nine-reference IDs do not resolve all of them
rows.remark: Conditional on material occurrence. Do not map PVC or ABC to ANT only because that reference exists. [PDF, LOOKUP, MDB]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Whitespace and alias approval for conductor IDs
rows.purpose: Decide whether literal leading-space references are aliases or distinct entries in the receiving library.
rows.format: Reviewed mapping of exact strings; preserve spaces until confirmed
rows.sample: Observed: ANT / " ANT", DOG / " DOG", GNAT / " GNAT", WASP / " WASP"
rows.remark: Conditional where affected IDs are used; all four families have reported reference variants. [MDB]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Secondary-link neutral model and continuity
rows.purpose: Resolve the neutral conductor and connection when the link is declared to carry N.
rows.format: Approved NeutralConductorId and confirmed phase/neutral schedule
rows.sample: Reference link SectionPhases=RYBN but NeutralConductorId is blank
rows.remark: Conditional on N being declared. Full section validation rejects an active N without a reviewed conductor reference. [EPB, MDB]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Historic first-S / KMZ root coordinates
rows.purpose: Provide verified historic root coordinates where the first S reference is absent from the selected GPX.
rows.format: Verified latitude/longitude and source evidence; current source association
rows.sample: PDFs contain historic transformer references separate from new GPS sequences
rows.remark: Conditional on unmatched historic root. The first S KMZ reference cannot be replaced by a same-number unrelated GPX point. [NV, PDF]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Ambiguous or repeated waypoint identity resolution
rows.purpose: Confirm complete group/date/GPS identity and source selection where names or repeated observations do not uniquely identify a point.
rows.format: Complete text identifier, selected GPX source and verified coordinate binding
rows.sample: GPX labels alone do not encode an approved electrical association
rows.remark: Conditional on ambiguity or missing matches; keep leading zeros in text IDs. [NV, GPX]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Branch, intersection and normally-open connection resolution
rows.purpose: Confirm which observed points are electrically connected when paper intersection flags or a branched layout are ambiguous.
rows.format: Verified S/E edge schedule and radial source-connected topology
rows.sample: PDF Int flags exist; legacy Angle/Tap_Pole/End_Type equivalence is unconfirmed
rows.remark: Conditional on ambiguity/loops. Current exporter rejects cycles; it does not infer electrical connectivity from Int or proximity. [NV, EPB, PDF]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Route geometry or measured span length
rows.purpose: Supply route vertices or an approved measured length when straight endpoint distance is insufficient for the modeled section.
rows.format: geometry coordinate list, or positive measured_length_m in metres
rows.sample: Source section lengths may match endpoint distances; GPX waypoints do not always define the route
rows.remark: Conditional override. A measured length requires reason, provenance and verifier approval; no additional fixed length is assumed. [NV, EPB]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Coordinate correction and approval
rows.purpose: Confirm corrected coordinates and the reason when a recorded GPX point is wrong or missing.
rows.format: Finite latitude/longitude within geographic bounds; reason and authorized approval
rows.sample: No universal correction can be derived from a reference model
rows.remark: Conditional on correction. Preserve original coordinates; approval is required before the corrected point is used. [NV, EPB]

rows.category: F. Conditional resolution of survey and library ambiguities
rows.name: Additional capacities / mixed construction models
rows.purpose: Provide models and a mapping approach for surveyed capacities or constructions not represented by the consolidated library.
rows.format: Exact new reviewed type/configuration IDs and per-network mapping where supported
rows.sample: Nine files only establish 50/100/200 KVA type labels and one configuration ID
rows.owner: Transformer Engineering / Distribution Design / Software Team
rows.remark: Conditional on occurrence. Central settings currently apply one configuration; heterogeneous construction may need explicit mapping review. [EC, EPB]

rows.category: G. Category-rate demand inputs (only when category_rates is selected)
rows.name: RS demand rate (1-phase residential)
rows.purpose: Provide the approved per-customer apparent-demand rate used to convert the verified category count into estimated demand.
rows.format: Numeric kVA/consumer, 0 to 1,000,000; supported rate input
rows.sample: No category-specific rate in MDBs; aggregate ratios include about 3, 3.8667, 4 and 5
rows.remark: Conditional: category_rates mode requires a rate for every category, including RS. Aggregate historical ratios are not an approved rate schedule. [EC]

rows.category: G. Category-rate demand inputs (only when category_rates is selected)
rows.name: RS lagging power factor
rows.purpose: Provide the approved factor used to calculate kW and kvar from the category apparent-demand estimate.
rows.format: Numeric factor greater than 0 and at most 1; lagging model in current automatic method
rows.sample: No usable value: reference positive kVA has zero kW and kvar
rows.remark: Conditional: category_rates requires PF for RS. Signed measured kvar or another allocation method uses the verified-demand workflow. [EC, NV]
